name: llm-tokenizer
description: Count tokens for 85 AI models directly in your editor — exact counts for GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral and more.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Workspace files are only read and tokenized; nothing from the workspace is executed.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Token counting runs in a Node worker thread and reports results by file system path, so it is unavailable on virtual file systems.

llm-tokenizer.statusBarDisplay.description: What to show in the status bar.

llm-tokenizer.ignoreGitignoredFiles.description: Exclude files matched by .gitignore from folder and workspace totals. Only the .gitignore at the root of each workspace folder is read, plus .git/info/exclude. Build directories such as node_modules, dist and out are always excluded.

llm-tokenizer.enableProjectScan.description: Count tokens across the whole workspace. Turn this off on very large repositories; per-file and per-folder counting keeps working.

llm-tokenizer.downloadTokenizers.description: Download a model's real tokenizer the first time it is needed, so counts are exact instead of estimated. Only applies to models whose tokenizer is published; Claude and Grok have none, and stay estimated either way. Downloads come from huggingface.co, are cached on disk, and never include your code.
